limitations_and_boundaries: Only four datasets used, all from cancer cell lines.
Original quality control not improved; e.g., perturbations that did not affect target gene expression were not excluded.
Theodoris et al. excluded cancer cell lines from training data due to high mutational burden; this study did not.
Benchmark focused on limited number of models and datasets; results may not generalize.

experiments_or_tasks: Benchmark prediction of effects of unseen single perturbations using two CRISPRi datasets by Replogle et al. (K562 and RPE1 cells) and one by Adamson et al. (K562 cells).

methods.name: Baseline linear model
methods.protocol_description: Simple linear model: represents each read-out gene with K-dimensional vector G and each perturbation with L-dimensional vector P. G and P obtained from PCA of training data or external sources. W solved via normal equations with ridge penalty λ=0.1. Also included a 'mean' baseline predicting average training expression.

methods.name: Deep learning models for single perturbations
methods.protocol_description: GEARS, scGPT, scFoundation, UCE, scBERT, Geneformer used as in double perturbation benchmark. CPA excluded as not designed for unseen perturbations. scFoundation excluded due to gene matching issues.

methods.name: Benchmark setup
methods.protocol_description: Test–training splitting from GEARS 'simulation' procedure, repeated twice. Prediction error measured as L2 distance for 1,000 most highly expressed genes. Analysis restricted to perturbations where all models had predictions (73 for Adamson, 398 for Replogle K562, 629 for Replogle RPE1).

datasets.name: Norman et al. 2019

experiments_or_tasks: Assess prediction of expression changes after double perturbations using data from Norman et al., with 100 individual genes and 124 gene pairs upregulated in K562 cells.

methods.name: Deep learning models benchmarked
methods.protocol_description: Five foundation models (scGPT, scFoundation, UCE, scBERT, Geneformer) and two other deep learning models (GEARS, CPA) were fine-tuned or used as per original publications. For Geneformer, UCE, and scBERT, a linear decoder (ridge regression) was added to map cell embeddings to gene expression. Fine-tuning limits: GEARS and scFoundation limited to 3 days; scFoundation trained for 5 epochs. UCE used zero-shot with data leakage accepted. scGPT parameters from tutorial.

methods.name: Baseline models
methods.protocol_description: Two simple baselines: (1) 'no change' model predicting control expression; (2) 'additive' model predicting sum of individual log-fold changes. Neither uses double perturbation data.

methods.name: Benchmark setup
methods.protocol_description: Models fine-tuned on all 100 single perturbations and 62 randomly chosen double perturbations; tested on remaining 62 double perturbations. Analysis repeated 5 times with different random partitions. Prediction error measured as L2 distance for 1,000 most highly expressed genes. Also evaluated using Pearson delta and L2 for other gene subsets.
